summary: Boot Barn Holdings filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to its existing credit agreement and quarterly financial results. The amendment increases the revolving credit commitment from $250 million to $500 million, extends the maturity to July 2031, and revises the accordion feature to allow up to $750 million. These are routine financing and operational updates, not a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. The filing is a standard current report with no event triggering a special-situations classification.
